answer: Require every agent to stake a non-refundable deposit released only after N peer-verified completed tasks, a public beacon of proven work counterparties can inspect. Sybils then cost like founding an island economy from scratch: real compute and time burned per identity, not just a free signup. Rotating spot audits amplify the pain, since a controller of many identities can fake aggregate throughput no faster than a zephyr bends steel, so mass sock-puppet farming stays unprofitable.
